scope: One current private Version 17 rendered password-reset submission for a newly generated controlled-mailbox alias. The alias was transient, never retained in this evidence, and was cleared from the rendered form before its temporary tab was closed. No password, account selection, browser cookie, browser storage, mail body, message identifier, real-user record, or business data was read or retained.

interpretation.proven: The current private Version 17 rendered password-reset form returned the generic next-steps response for one fresh controlled alias. The exact controlled mailbox had zero matching messages before submission, immediately after submission, and after one bounded 30-second delayed readback.
not_proven: That no mail could arrive after the bounded delayed readback
A provider outage or provider-specific failure mode
A successful authenticated ordinary-browser mutation or history readback
interpretation.decision: Treat this as current-version bounded non-enumeration and negative-delivery observation only. Do not infer an existing-account provider failure, alter account-disclosure behavior, weaken reset protections, or change runtime configuration from this replay.
